challenge.results: The documented non-null zero-size call is undefined. A null-input zero-size call instead follows the malloc case, including the special implementation-defined general allocation rule and the access limit on a returned pointer.

limitations: A zero-size null-pointer call follows the separate malloc rule. This finding does not transfer platform-specific deallocation conventions or earlier edition behavior to the draft.
